gaps.topic: Identity of TSMC's, Intel's, GF's and SMIC's largest customers
gaps.why: The filings give concentration percentages but do not name the customers in the quoted passages. Pairing them with a customer would be speculation.
gaps.would_need: A customer-side filing that names the foundry and a matching revenue share, or a 20-F that names the customer.

gaps.why: TSMC's 20-F gives only company-wide annual capacity (>17 million 12-inch equivalent wafers in 2025), and its GIGAFAB page gives only a combined >13 million figure for the six GIGAFABs.
gaps.would_need: A TSMC disclosure with per-fab capacity (not published in the 20-F or on the GIGAFAB page).

gaps.topic: Facility-level allocation of equipment and wafer supply to specific TSMC fabs
gaps.why: Supplier filings and TSMC's supplier award release name TSMC at company level only. TSMC's 20-F does not mention EUV or name tool suppliers.
gaps.would_need: Import records, supplier disclosures naming specific fabs, or TSMC statements tying EUV to specific fabs and nodes.

gaps.topic: Intel fab site addresses (Hillsboro D1X, Chandler Fab 52, Leixlip, Kiryat Gat, New Albany)
gaps.why: The 10-K names states or countries only. Precise site names come from Intel newsroom pages, which were unreachable here (redirects / socket errors).
gaps.would_need: Reachable Intel newsroom or permit documents naming each site.
